content.value: A 5m depth cf sand overlies a 4m layer of clay. The water table is at 3m below the G.S. The unit weight of sand is 17 kN/m³. The saturated unit weight of sand is 20 kN/m³ and that of the ciay is 19kN/m³.Show how the stresses are affected if the WT rises to the G.S.
